mappings.rationale: BPS Vol.2 crosswalk confirms a bidirectional 1:1 pairing, not a title-similarity guess: Lampiran 5 (2020->2025 direction, p.135, image-verified) shows KBLI2020 02401 'Jasa Penggunaan Kawasan Hutan Di Luar Sektor Kehutanan' -> KBLI2025 02402 'Jasa Penggunaan Kawasan Kehutanan'; Lampiran 10 (2025->2020 reverse direction, p.330, image-verified) shows the SAME single pairing in reverse, 02402 -> 02401, with no other row for 02402 on the adjacent page (p.329, checked, confirmed absent). This rules out SPLIT (02401 has no second 2025 target across either table) and MERGE (02402 has no second 2020 source). Semantically, both uraian describe the identical regulatory core, not just a similar label: the 2020 title's qualifier 'Di Luar Sektor Kehutanan' (forest-area use OUTSIDE the forestry sector itself, i.e. non-forestry activity sited inside a forest zone under a use-permit) is restated by the 2025 canonical uraian in its own words -- 'jasa kehutanan bidang penggunaan kawasan hutan tanpa mengubah fungsi dan peruntukan kawasan hutan' (forestry services for using a forest area WITHOUT changing the area's function/designation). Both encode a forest-area-use-permit service, which is what separates this from the numerically-coincidental 2020 code 02402 'Jasa Perlindungan Hutan Dan Konservasi Alam' (protection/conservation) -- the SAME lampiran5 page maps that different 2020 code instead to 2025's 02101 'Pengelolaan Hutan', proving the 02402 numeral match across editions is not the basis of this mapping. oss/relasi.json corroborates the placement under golongan pokok 02 / subgolongan 0240 'Jasa Penunjang Kehutanan' (fee/contract-basis forestry services), and canonical.json's own l4_bali.reason independently states 'ex-02401 recoding Jasa Penggunaan Kawasan Hutan', matching the crosswalk finding derived here from the images.

payload.notes: Crosswalk mapping 02401(2020)<->02402(2025) is a clean, image-confirmed bidirectional ONE_TO_ONE (both BPS Lampiran 5 forward and Lampiran 10 reverse tables agree, single row each side, uraian-level semantic match on the 'forest-area use without changing forest designation' concept). pp28/ABSENT.json shows zero PP28 lampiran image evidence for this code (21 files / 11,208 pages scanned, verdict absent), and the canonical record's own _source_relabeled note states the content is OSS-RBA-2025-native, not a KBLI-2020-vintage PP28 extraction -- so licensing_inherits=false and no D2 row-extraction is applicable/possible for this code. Separate, out-of-scope data-quality flag for the maintainers: canonical.json's per_skala.persyaratan/kewajiban text for this code is entirely about forest-plant seed/seedling (benih/bibit) certification, which does not semantically match the code's own uraian (forest-area-use service) -- looks like possible payload cross-contamination from a neighboring code (e.g. 02103 Pembenihan Tanaman Kehutanan). This does not affect the crosswalk verdict above (which rests only on the BPS lampiran images + the code's own uraian/judul), but is worth a downstream licensing-payload integrity check.

reasons: Independently re-read lampiran5_p135, lampiran10_p329, lampiran10_p330 images (not D1's text) before consulting the proposal: confirmed 02401(2020)<->02402(2025) is a single row on both the forward and reverse BPS tables, with the immediately adjacent rows on each page being different codes — this rules out SPLIT (page shows repeated-source rows elsewhere, e.g. 02130 x3, for genuine splits) and MERGE independently, not by trusting D1's characterization.
Verified p.329 genuinely ends at 02401->02409 with no 02402 row, matching D1's 'adjacent page checked, confirmed absent' claim — a specific falsifiable detail that held up.

Verified the numeral-coincidence control: 2020-code 02402 (forest protection/conservation) maps to 2025-02101 on both p.135 and p.329 independently, confirming the 02402 digit match across editions is not the mapping basis.

Verified pp28/ABSENT.json (21 files, 11,208 pages, verdict absent) and canonical.json's _l1_source=OSS_RBA_2025 + _source_relabeled note independently support licensing_inherits=false: the payload is OSS-RBA-2025-native, not a carried-over 2020-vintage PP28 extraction.

Read oss/relasi.json directly and found the official subgolongan 0240 scope note explicitly EXCLUDES 'pembenihan tanaman hutan, lihat subgolongan 0210' -- independent confirmation (going one step further than D1's proposal text) that the per_skala persyaratan/kewajiban content (100% benih/bibit seed-certification) cannot legitimately belong under 02402/0240, corroborating D1's own self-flagged cross-contamination note as accurate and appropriately scoped as separate from the crosswalk verdict.
No divergence found between independent re-derivation and the proposal on mapping_type, licensing_inherits, or needs_quarantine scoping.
